assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated item, reviewed-dedicated-analysis: the canonical V2 character reconstruction model MHA_SP2_SHOJI_MEZO_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its SM-SUP-01 to SM-SUP-03 sections admit. The MHA character modeling schema was consulted for method only; the readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit and the deep readings are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's strong label and its retrospective holdout probe are inputs, not conclusions. The V37:p148 authorial kimono illustration is excluded, as the model's source correction requires. No original manga page, anime adaptation, V1 material or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Shoji from the V09:p132-176 injured protection of Tokoyami, through the V37:p133-145 and p154-164 disclosure of village persecution, scars and mask, rejection of a revenger identity and challenge to attacks on uninvolved people, to the V42:p132 regional-work award and the V42:p163 peer caution about words. Kept as separable states: injured student teammate, student speaking in the heteromorph crisis, and adult regional hero; the V37:p148 author drawing is not an in-world state. No atom covers V01-V08, V10-V36 or V38-V41.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states a recurring hierarchy (protect people presently exposed to harm, refuse a revenge identity, make better meanings for the same body, sustain reform beyond one hero), an ideal of a hero who makes a different future thinkable and a feared self whose scars are read as a mandate for revenge, grounded in SM02-SM04, three of them directly checked; the probe SM-V01 rates motive supported. Not B: one compact artifact with five atoms in three volumes and one retrospective nonblind probe; private adult conflict and intimate relations are insufficient by the model's own account. Not D: the decision policy is explicit with stated changes for immediate bodily danger, peer speech and public recognition.

Three sampled states are separated: the injured student teammate (SM01, V09), the student in the heteromorph crisis (SM02-SM03, V37) and the adult regional hero (SM04-SM05, V42). The located V37-to-V42 relation is continuity of the generational policy rather than located change, and nothing locates development between V09 and V37. Not C: no located transition shows how he changed, and the model's REVISE of quiet kindness is a correction of the analyst's model, not a character change. Not E: the states are located and kept separate, with the adult state not given to the student.

The model identifies 俺, comparatively measured explanation, the explicit rejection of 復讐者 as self-identity and the distinction about how anger is used as load-bearing (SM02-SM03), warns against generic pacifist softness and against moral proverbs in every line, and the probe rates speech/register supported. Not C: no located lines are quoted and the model calls private and intimate register low-confidence. Not E: a register and its markers are identified and tested on one axis. The discovery row does not enroll SPEECH.

The one located ordinary window is SM05, a peer affirmation and caution in familiar group interaction, which the model rates high for the scene but limited for broad ordinary life. Taciturn company with Koda, off-duty clothing and the laugh at Koda's hair remark are supplement editorial summary, profile fact and gag (SM-SUP-02). Not D: one enacted ordinary window, and the model warns it does not establish a broad private social life.

A five-row partner table gives conditional differences toward Class A, Tokoyami and endangered teammates, Koda, the aggrieved heteromorph crowd and the adult public and peers, each located in one window (SM01-SM05); the Koda row rests mainly on supplements, and the probe rates relationship handling supported for the public-credit context. Not C: no partner is tracked across states, so no relationship delta is located, and the model says private adult relationship variation remains limited. Not E: partner-specific conduct is located for several partners.

Located interior material is his own V37 account of persecution, scars and the mask, and his apology for not noticing others' suffering (SM02-SM03, directly checked); the model reads restraint as active management of how pain is interpreted, not absence of anger. The probe rates emotional trajectory underdetermined, since public composure does not disclose the private response. Not C: one self-disclosure window, and regulation is described for specific contexts only. Not E: a located self-account exists.

The decision policy is explicit: preserve the truth of grievance, identify who is actually threatened, oppose retaliatory transfer of harm, seek a feasible protective or reform action, and acknowledge distributed credit; immediate bodily danger gives sensory protection priority. Its branches are located in SM01 (field protection while injured, medium-high) and SM03 (the crowd confrontation). Not C: each branch rests on a single window, and the model itself says the sample supports specific contexts more strongly than every stress regime. Not E: the policy is stated and located.

SM03 (directly checked) locates explicit normative reasoning: he validates the grievance while challenging attacks on uninvolved people, asks how anger is used, and frames change across generations rather than declaring discrimination solved; SM04 carries the same policy into public credit eight years later. Not B: one deliberative window, extended by one later page, and responses to unobserved betrayal are OPEN. Not D: competing goods are named and weighed in his own words, not only inferred from conduct. The discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.
The model analyzes no humor practice; the attributed laugh at Koda's hair remark is a supplement gag (SM-SUP-02), not analyzed play. This gap says nothing about the character.

The project's analytical corpus is complete for V01-V42 and the admitted supplements, but the evidence set has five atoms in three volumes (V09, V37, V42), four of them directly checked, with V10-V36 entirely unsampled; the model also excludes V37:p148 as authorial material. Not D: the located sample is local to one field scene, one crisis volume and two adult pages.

Affirmative limits are located: the model REJECTs revenge essentialism and the use of the V37:p148 illustration as behavior, says restraint is not absence of anger and forbids total serenity or a clinical diagnosis, says he cannot know every persecuted person's experience (SM03), says the rescued girl's reasons are hers and his reaction and a reunion are not drawn (SM-SUP-03), and says the regional glossary does not erase his granular history (SM-SUP-01). Not B: the limits rest on few windows in one artifact.

Atoms are page-located, three are directly checked, the V31 page convention is stated, the V37:p148 source correction is explicit, and the frozen probe uses SM01-SM03 only and keeps V42:p163 out of the held-out outcome. Not B: two of three states rest on one volume each, intervals are long and unsampled, and in-world dates are not given beyond the eight-year frame.

scenario_readiness.note: The model quotes no located lines, calls private register low-confidence and states that generated dialogue would be an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation. Lines beyond the described register would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Shoji's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state, stated explicitly: injured student teammate (V09), student in the heteromorph crisis (V37) or adult regional hero (V42); adult public credit is not given to the student.

The interlocutor is a Class A peer, an endangered teammate, an aggrieved heteromorph crowd, the adult public or adult peers, handled as the partner table gives; no invented private or romantic relationship.

The scenario is protective field action, a grievance-versus-harm confrontation or public recognition; private conflicts where safety and accountability compete are low confidence and are not predicted.
Output is a behavioral description with alternatives; no quoted dialogue is produced as canon, emotional mixture is left open, and no readiness is inherited from the strong label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: V09 injured student, V37 crisis student or V42 adult regional hero, stated explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Class A peers, endangered teammates, an aggrieved heteromorph crowd, the adult public or adult peers, in the relation the partner table gives.
setting_constraints: Field protection, a public confrontation over grievance and harm, or public recognition of regional work
Dupli-Arms sensory and protective limits and current injury respected
No adult private, intimate or family setting

scenario_readiness.note: The model's stated hypothetical (adult Shoji asked to accept sole credit for a regional intervention: acknowledges specific collaborators while owning his work, high confidence in the public-credit context; a hostile crowd threatening patients calls for firmer immediate opposition) and the probe's supported action, motive and relationship axes support narrow novel scenes. The probe is retrospective, nonblind and underdetermined on emotional trajectory.
One located ordinary peer window (SM05) and supplement texture (SM-SUP-02) do not support ordinary social simulation; the model says they do not establish a broad private adult social network.

conditions: The dilemma sets a real grievance against harm to uninvolved people, or individual credit against collective history, with the state named.
Output preserves the truth of the grievance, opposes retaliatory transfer of harm, rejects instant solutions to long-standing barriers, and does not condemn the excluded wholesale.
Responses to unobserved betrayal and private dilemmas where safety and accountability compete are not predicted; the model marks them OPEN or lower confidence.
scenario_readiness.note: SM03 (directly checked) and its continuation in SM04 support bounded grievance-and-harm and credit dilemmas only.
The model says intimate relationships remain insufficient; the evidence set establishes neither romantic conduct nor its absence. That limits inference; it says nothing about the character.

conditions: The setting is protective field action or public recognition of adult regional work, with the state stated.
Output preserves distributed credit, connection of achievement to continuing social work, and protective priority under immediate danger.
Detailed adult agency operations, casework and career decisions beyond SM04 are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Professional conduct is located in the V09 field protection (SM01) and the V42 regional-work award (SM04, directly checked), and the probe's held-out comparison is this public-credit context; the adult professional state rests on one page.

known_limits.statement: He rejects being read as a revenger and the model REJECTs revenge essentialism; the wound is real but does not exhaust his body or identity (SM02-SM03).

His opposition to harm against uninvolved people coexists with validating the grievance; blanket condemnation of the aggrieved crowd and instant solutions to long-standing barriers are both excluded (SM03).
Restraint and the mask are active management of how pain is interpreted, not evidence of absent anger, total serenity or healed trauma; no clinical diagnosis is supported.
V37:p148 is an authorial kimono illustration and contributes no behavioral or speech evidence; the model's source correction excludes it.
He cannot know every persecuted person's experience or the sincerity of institutional reform from personal resolve; his apology for not noticing others' suffering is epistemically relevant (SM03).
The rescued girl's delayed contact and letter are an author-disclosed account of her side; his detailed reaction and any reunion are not supplied (SM-SUP-03).
Supplement editorial summaries, profile facts, the gag and the author comment (SM-SUP-01 to SM-SUP-03) constrain reconstruction without becoming enacted manga observations.
The single formal probe SM-V01 is a retrospective chronological evidence holdout by an analyst who had read later manga, not a blind experiment; emotional trajectory was underdetermined.
Private adult conflict, intimate relationships, the reach of reform and responses to unobserved betrayal are insufficient or OPEN in the model.
No atom covers V01-V08, V10-V36 or V38-V41, so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.

The deep readings, readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not independently rechecked here. Anime performance and any supplement material beyond what the model cites lie outside this evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
